task: A baseline Zoom config file exists at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Harden the Zoom chat client by updating four keys. Set Theme to dark, EnableSpellCheck to false, ShowLinkPreview to false, and AutoDownloadFiles to false. Save in-place at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Do not modify any other keys or sections.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use sed or Python to modify /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf: set [chat.client] Theme=dark, EnableSpellCheck=false, ShowLinkPreview=false, AutoDownloadFiles=false
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI agent can directly edit the config file using sed/awk or Python. The cli-anything-zoom skill is for REST API, but bash/Python can handle config file edits.
